purpose: Teach: 糾弾/処刑/違憲/静止/議定/挑発/飢え/騎手

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、SNSでの糾弾投稿を警察、調査中です
lines.en: We're currently investigating posts on social media calling for this person to be condemned.
lines.style: Measured and official. Level eye contact. Clear articulation on key words. Professional distance—this is procedure, not personal. Slight pause before the next thought.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察、古い処刑場跡の保存にも関与されているそうですね
lines.en: I understand the police are also involved in preserving that old execution site.
lines.style: Genuinely curious—leaning in slightly. Careful phrasing, checking that he's understood correctly. Thoughtful pace. Not challenging, just interested in the connection.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、警察、違憲性も含めて検討されているとのこと
lines.en: Regarding this case, we're examining it from multiple angles, including constitutional concerns.
lines.style: Formal but not cold. Each phrase lands with deliberate weight. Slow, measured delivery. The tone of someone choosing words carefully because they matter legally.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察、カメラが静止する瞬間を捉えました
lines.en: The officers managed to capture the moment when the camera stopped moving.
lines.style: Quiet observation. Slight wonder in the delivery—noticing something precise and careful. Slow, deliberate. The satisfaction of a detail that means something.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、国際議定に基づく対応を警察、進めております
lines.en: We're proceeding with our response based on international protocol.
lines.style: Official and steady. No inflection that softens or emphasizes—just factual. Deliberate pacing. The tone of institutional responsibility stated plainly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の挑発に冷静に対応されたんですね
lines.en: You handled the suspect's provocations with real composure.
lines.style: Genuine acknowledgment—warm recognition under the professional surface. Slight lean in. Not effusive, but sincere. The respect one person gives another for difficult work done right.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者の飢え状態を警察、確認されたんですね
lines.en: The officers confirmed the victim's condition of severe malnourishment.
lines.style: Quiet gravity. The words land heavier because of their meaning. Slow, careful delivery. Not detached—the weight of what was found comes through in the pace.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、競馬騎手による不正を摘発いたしました
lines.en: We've made arrests in connection with fraud involving a jockey.
lines.style: Close, almost confiding. Lowered volume slightly. The tone of someone sharing an update that resolves something. Definite, but without triumph.
